# Six institutions join the research map

The [research map](/network/index.html) now lists **46 institutions in 14
countries**. The six new profiles come from the
[IR-EMPOWER 2026 programme](/ir-empower/2026/index.html). The workshop's talks
are among the public evidence the map's [methodology](/network/methodology.html)
uses, and each profile was checked against the institution's own pages and
peer-reviewed publications.

| Institution | Tier | What it brings |
|---|---|---|
| [LNE](/network/lne-trappes.html), Trappes | Core | France's national metrology institute: SI-traceable directional spectral emissivity (250 nm–20 µm) and calorimetric total hemispherical emissivity |
| [JRC Karlsruhe](/network/jrc-karlsruhe.html) | Extended | Spectral emissivity of laser-heated nuclear and ultra-refractory materials above 1500 K |
| [BAM](/network/bam-berlin.html), Berlin | Extended | Hyperspectral thermography and emissivity-aware temperature measurement in metal additive manufacturing |
| [IETcc-CSIC](/network/csic-ietcc.html), Madrid | Extended | An open dataset of solar reflectance and thermal emittance for 236 construction materials |
| [UNT](/network/unt-denton.html), Denton | Engineered emissivity | Thermal-radiation coatings for spacecraft and lunar exploration |
| [THWS](/network/thws-schweinfurt.html), Schweinfurt / Würzburg | Emerging | Calibrated in-situ thermography for laser powder bed fusion |

Every speaker institution at IR-EMPOWER 2026 now has a profile on the map,
except the one company on the programme (the map lists non-commercial
institutions only).

Is your laboratory missing, or is its profile out of date? Tell us through the
[contribution form](/contribute/index.html).

*Emissivity.org Editorial Board · 25 September 2026.*
:::
